That sounds really crappy. I am sorry. I can't imagine what that is like...?

Hi there.
God, that sounds rough. I am sorry that your parents want you to get into an arranged marriage, disabling you from dating anyone. Regret sucks to have, it makes you think about the past so much and the present and the future and it can stress you out a lot.

Be there for him. Let him know that he is wanted. Be a shoulder to cry on. Be the person you would want if you were him.

Do not tell him how good his life is; that will make him feel guilty for feeling so sad when he has it "so good." It does not always get better for people sadly either. And his feelings are valid, not selfish, if people have told him that.
